children: HCL Technologies Limited (NSE:HCLTECH) faces a mixed moment: a U.S. Labor Department pause on PERM filings clouds talent sourcing even as Q2 FY27 forecasts and analyst upgrades signal modest revenue and margin gains, AI expansion, South Africa HQ, Lucknow investment and steady dividends bolster its growth story.
Previous Week Recap
PERM Filings Paused For HCLTECH
: US Labor Department paused PERM filings for HCL Technologies, blocking new and pending employment-based green card applications for visa holders, citing concerns over overseas hiring.
HCLTECH Q2 FY27 Outlook
: HCLTECH reports Q2 FY27 results Oct 12. Analysts expect ~2.4% sequential CC revenue growth and ~3% QoQ services growth, aided by Jaspersoft and HPE Telco contributions.
HDFC Starts Buy On HCLTECH
: HDFC Securities starts a buy on HCLTECH with Rs 1,370 target (~11% upside). Sees ~2% QoQ CC revenue growth, ~50bp operating margin improvement, and ~10–20bp currency headwind.
HCLTECH Dividend Yields Announced
: HCLTECH paid dividends: Rs54/share (FY26), Rs60 (FY25), Rs52 (FY24). Dividend yields: ~4.1% (FY26), ~4.6% (FY25), ~4.0% (FY24).
Analysts See HCLTECH PAT Growth
: Analyst forecasts for HCL Technologies (HCLTECH) predict Q2 FY27 PAT growth: Nuvama sees ~15.9% year‑over‑year and ~6.2% quarter‑over‑quarter; Motilal Oswal sees ~21.3% year‑over‑year.
HCLTECH Results In AI Era
: HCL Technologies (HCLTECH) reports quarterly results alongside peers; traders watch earnings for AI impact, geopolitics, and client spending trends affecting Indian IT sector.
HCLTECH Top Pick After Rebound
: HCL Technologies (HCLTECH) noted as a top pick after a technical rebound: price respected a horizontal demand shelf, formed a bullish engulfing on higher volume and trades within a falling wedge.
HCLTECH Opens Johannesburg HQ
: HCL Technologies opened a Johannesburg regional HQ and AI Center of Excellence offering full-stack AI services and local training, expanding HCLTECH’s South Africa operations and talent pipeline.
HCLTECH ₹500 Crore Investment In Lucknow
: HCL Technologies will invest ₹500 crore to add up to 9.5 lakh sq ft in Lucknow IT City, creating workspace for about 4,500 tech employees.
Divya Gupta Appointed Associate Director HR

: HCL Technologies (HCLTECH) named Divya Gupta Associate Director, HR effective October 2026. Gupta, with 16+ years at HCL, last led HR for Digital Foundation Services covering 30,000 global employees.
